content: For individuals with type 2 diabetes, achieving and maintaining a weight loss of 10% or more of their body weight can lead to significant health benefits. Additionally, this level of weight loss may decrease the risk of long-term complications associated with type 2 diabetes, such as cardiovascular disease. Furthermore, it can enhance overall quality of life and improve physical functioning. These findings highlight the importance of establishing realistic and achievable weight loss goals as a critical component of diabetes management.
